description: Harden the public LLM authoring, inspection, visual review, and evidence workflow

sprint.goal: Make the supported static asset workflow independently discoverable, safely editable, visually reviewable, and reproducible by a fresh MCP-capable LLM without source knowledge.
sprint.demo_notes: Phases S1 and S2 are owner-approved. Complete state inspection, semantic revision comparison, and honest machine-readable capability discovery now establish the supported static authoring boundary.
